name: Keymarchy
author: sonlndv
description: Input languages for Omarchy, built on fcitx5. English and Vietnamese (Telex/VNI) by default; add Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Thai, Arabic, Russian, Hebrew, Greek and more. Ctrl+Shift cycles through your languages, and a small dashboard manages them all.

barWidget.description: Language badge (EN, VI, JA, AR…) with a menu to switch, add and remove languages, plus a Keymarchy Settings dashboard. Ctrl+Shift or right click cycles through your languages.

schema.label: Fallback refresh (ms)
schema.description: The badge updates on its own when you switch with Keymarchy, Ctrl+Shift or a window change. This slow check only catches switches made with fcitx5's own hotkeys.

schema.label: Show the input mode next to the badge (Telex/VNI, Pinyin/Zhuyin)
